profile.headline: Sr. Software Development Engineer @ Amazon | Distributed Systems & Streaming | Java, AWS, Kotlin | Team Leadership & High-Scale Services
profile.summary:
Senior Software Development Engineer with 9+ years building scalable, high-performance distributed systems at Amazon Prime Video. I specialize in backend services, cross-platform mobile integrations (Android & iOS), and cloud-native architectures using Java, Kotlin, GraphQL, and AWS technologies.

At Prime Video, I’ve helped shape core systems used by hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. I’ve led teams, delivered resilient high-throughput services, and solved complex technical challenges like cross-region resiliency, traffic optimization, and IPv6 enablement at scale.

I thrive at the intersection of architecture, execution, and customer experience, turning large-scale problems into robust solutions that run globally.

Tech highlights: Java, Kotlin, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3), Android/iOS, Distributed Systems, High Availability, Microservices, GraphQL, Caching Systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon – Prime Video

Senior SDE | Title Lifecycle | 2026-Present 

Personalized title ranking | 700K TPS, North America

- Designed an ML ranking system, in partnership with an applied scientist, that selects the best title text for each customer using pre-computed cohort data.
- Design a layered fallback strategy for resiliency: an XGBoost model for exploration when customer data is sparse, then the existing cascade ranking as a safety net.
- Own design and cross-team alignment across product, partner teams, and dependent services
- Lead 4 engineers delivering the ranker service, alongside other company-level strategic initiatives


Senior SDE | Prime Video Downloads | 2021–2025

- Lead engineer for Downloads (80M+ daily customers) across Android, iOS, and Windows; managed 10 engineers (backend + mobile) owning roadmap, architecture, and operations
- Designed cross-region resiliency and traffic rerouting for AWS regional failures
- Re-architected device sync, cutting service traffic ~40%
- Launched NBA download capability across backend, mobile, and partner teams

Tech: Java, Kotlin, AWS, Android/iOS, Distributed Systems, High-Availability Architecture


Software Development Engineer II | Freevee | 2019–2021

Freevee launch (ad-supported streaming) | 10M+ daily customers

- Core engineer for the launch of Freevee; built platform modules supporting global release.
- Designed and delivered the Continue Watching system across devices for stateful playback.
- Led IPv6 enablement; first Amazon product to serve IPv6 commercial traffic at scale

Tech: Java, Kotlin, GraphQL, Redis, AWS, Android, Cross-Platform Integrations


Software Development Engineer II | Prime Video CoreTech | 2017–2019

Prime Video content aggregator | 350M+ customers

- Built Java microservices handling 100K+ TPS across regions under strict latency SLAs
- Improved observability, on-call tooling, and cost efficiency.

Tech: Java, Multithreading, Concurrency, AWS, High-Throughput Distributed Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Omnitracs | Fleet Management & Real-Time Tracking Solutions
(SaaS platform for private and commercial fleets; solutions for routing, logistics, and remote vehicle monitoring)

- Led frontend development and UX design for the Command Center, the core platform enabling real-time fleet tracking and operator communication.
- Designed and implemented satellite vehicle tracking features using Google Maps APIs, enhancing geolocation accuracy and fleet visibility.
- Developed internal services to integrate Omnitracs systems with partner platforms (Roadnet, Navistar, Edenred), enabling secure data exchange (Java).
- Built a custom JavaScript framework to generate dynamic grids and forms, reducing development time for new UI modules.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate operational fleet requirements into scalable web solutions.

Technologies: Google Maps API, Java, Struts/Struts2, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Projects Done:

Omnitracs | Satellite Tracking Platform

Role: Designer & Full-Stack Developer
Time: Aug 2013 – Jun 2014 | Mexico

- Designed and developed a real-time vehicle satellite tracking web application for the Command Center.
- Implemented geolocation features using Google Maps APIs to improve fleet monitoring and operator response times.
- Built UI and backend components using HTML5, JavaScript, Java (Struts) to support scalable dispatch workflows.
- Collaborated with internal stakeholders to translate operational requirements into technical solutions.

Technologies: Google Maps API, HTML5, JavaScript, Java, Struts


Claro Cloud Colombia | Online Cloud Store

Role: Full-Stack Web Developer
Time: Jan 2013 – Aug 2013 | Mexico - Remote

- Developed the e-commerce storefront for Claro’s cloud services, enabling online subscription and activation.
- Built reusable UI components with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery to standardize user experience.
- Integrated backend functionality using PHP and Parallels Automation for billing and service provisioning.
- Ensured high-quality code through modular development and cross-team reviews.

Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, Parallels Automation, Smarty


Hewlett Packard US | Instant Ink Program

Role: Technical Lead & Full-Stack Engineer
Time: Aug 2011 – Jan 2013 | Mexico - Remote

- Led development of Landing Page and Printer Tab modules, improving onboarding flow for Instant Ink customers.
- Analyzed business requirements and translated them into detailed technical documentation and development tasks.
- Developed frontend and backend features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and PHP.
- Designed and optimized MySQL databases to improve query performance and data consistency.
- Managed version control and releases in UNIX environments using SVN, ensuring stable deployments.

Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, MySQL, SVN, UNIX

positions.title: Software Engineer (Professional Practice)
positions.description:
- Participated in end-to-end software development across multiple internal applications.
- Analyzed and defined functional requirements to guide architectural decisions.
- Developed frontend features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and ASC3.
- Built backend components and internal tools using PHP to streamline business operations.
- Designed and maintained MySQL databases to support application functionality and data integrity.
- Acted as a Technical Lead for selected modules, coordinating small development efforts and delivery timelines.

Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ASC3, PHP, MySQL
